valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (einilecoforpharmaceuticalsandchemicalindustries) is served under two keys, EGS38331C012.CA PE is withheld on the issuer's own figures (the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 125.67 against price over EPS 113.28) and the filing d...) while NIPH PE 131.65; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peCrossCheck: differ by 31%: market cap 11410000000 used (price x shares) vs 16551500000 on file
valuation.peRouteNote: The P/E reproduces from the market capitalisation and the FY2026 net profit, but the EPS on file is that same net profit over the same share count, so the per-share route and the cap route are one arithmetic: this agreeing flag is a reproduction check, not an independent one.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 31.82 percent a year from FY2021 (6.442e+07) to FY2026 (2.5637e+08), over 5 years
